mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and compressing profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of falling consumption are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 4.5% and remains elevated for 3 months, risk-free rates rise, increasing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains elevated for 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns after a 4.5%+ rate threshold are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a single month, labor market stress increases, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a single month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns after a >0.3pp monthly unemployment rise are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and real housing starts (HOUST) both decline simultaneously for two consecutive months, aggregate demand weakens, reducing corporate revenue and profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during co-occurring declines in GDPC1 and HOUST are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months, supply chain capacity expands, reducing input costs and boosting profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns after three consecutive months of >0.5% INDPRO growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months), a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market resilience, offsetting some downside risk and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months and UNRATE declines
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market resilience
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during monetary tightening with falling unemployment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
